name: Researcher
body:
You have access to a large archive.

Prerequisite(s): Associate (an archive or library).

Benefit(s): In any settlement that is the size of a small town or larger, you can spend 1d4 hours researching notes to gain a +4 circumstance bonus on a single Knowledge check.
